callouts.title: 定理1.1.1:数列的柯西判别
callouts.body: 实数列$x_n$收敛到实数$x$，当且仅当对于任意$\varepsilon>0$存在正整数$N_{\varepsilon}$使得任意$n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$都成立$$|x_n-x_m|<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: A real sequence $x_n$ converges to a real number $x$ if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a positive integer $N_{\varepsilon}$ such that for all $n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$, $$|x_n-x_m|<\varepsilon.$$
prerequisites: definition of convergence of a sequence

callouts.title: 定理1.1.2:区间套定理:实数版本
callouts.body: 实数$\mathbb{R}$当中的一列下降的闭区间套的交集非空。

classification_result.english_title: Theorem 1.1.2: Nested Interval Theorem, Real Version

if_problem.statement_en: The intersection of a decreasing sequence of closed intervals in $\mathbb{R}$ is nonempty.

callouts.title: 证明的主要计划
callouts.body:
证明的动机，实际上与[[函数与序列的上下极限]]当中的"命题1.1"有关。序列满足柯西判别的条件，实际上满足了序列有界性的条件，以及上下极限相等的条件，这就是为何这样的序列会存在极限的原因。

具体来说，如果序列满足柯西判别的条件，那么我们可以定义$$a_n:=\inf_{k\geq n}x_k,b_n:=\sup_{k\geq n}x_k$$此时定义$I_n:=[a_n,b_n]$，那么$I_n$可以构成一个"定理1.2"当中所要求的下降的区间套。因此这个区间套的交集当中存在一个实数$x$，其满足对任意足够大的$n$都满足$$a_n\leq x\leq b_n$$同时，当$k\geq n$的时候$a_n\leq x_k\leq b_n$，因此$$|x_k-x|\leq b_n-a_n$$然而柯西列的条件向我们保证了$b_n-a_n \to 0$。因此我们可以由此得到关于$|x_k-x|$上界的任意小的控制，从而证明序列收敛到$x$。

callouts.title: 定理1.1.3
callouts.body:
令$(a_n)$是度量空间$(X,d)$当中的序列，如果序列满足：对任意的$\varepsilon>0$都存在正整数$N_{\varepsilon}$使得对任意$m,n>N_{\varepsilon}$都有$$d(a_m,a_n)<\varepsilon$$那么就称这是该度量空间当中的一个柯西列。

完备度量空间当中的柯西列都收敛，且极限唯一。

callouts.title: 想法1.2.1
callouts.body:
1. 找到一个并不满足柯西收敛判别的子列。
2. 找到两个收敛的子列,$a_n,b_n$使得$|b_n-a_n|>\varepsilon_0$。这里面的一种特殊的做法是，找到两个收敛到不同结果的子列。

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Disprove the Cauchy Property via Subsequences
if_strategy_template.summary_en: To show a sequence is not Cauchy, either find a subsequence that itself fails the Cauchy criterion, or construct two convergent subsequences whose terms stay a definite distance apart. A particularly effective special case is to find two subsequences converging to different limits.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when proving that a sequence diverges or is not Cauchy, especially when direct lower bounds on $|a_n-a_m|$ are difficult to obtain.

callouts.title: 例子1.2.2:调和数列发散
callouts.body: 定义调和数列$$H_n:=\sum_{k\leq n}\frac{1}{k}$$现在我们来证明这个序列是发散的。我们现在忘记[[和的积分估计]]这个工具，单纯从"想法1.2.1"这个角度入手这个问题。所以我们现在的任务就是估计$|H_n-H_m|$的下界，但是我们发现这样的和增长很慢，下界不容易估计。于是我们本着，既然序列可能是发散的，那么不妨借助一个子列，从而让它发散地更快一些，更易于暴露其发散性质一些（这个想法参考[[用子列来提升收敛或发散性质#1.1 对于收敛序列，用子列来加速收敛或发散]]）。因此我们考虑子列$H_{2^n}$，结合[[逐项估计]]我们发现$$|H_{2^{n+1}}-H_{2^n}|=\sum_{k=1}^{2^n}\frac{1}{2^n+k}>\frac{2^n}{2^n+2^n}=\frac{1}{2}$$因此通过柯西判别，我们知道$H_{2^n}$这个子列是发散的。

classification_result.english_title: Example 1.2.2: Divergence of the Harmonic Sequence

if_problem.statement_en: Define the harmonic sequence $$H_n:=\sum_{k\leq n}\frac{1}{k}.$$ Prove that this sequence diverges.

callouts.title: 例子1.2.3
callouts.body: 序列$x_n:=(-1)^n$发散。因为我们可以找到两个收敛到不同结果的子列:$x_{2k}=1,x_{2k+1}=-1$，因此序列是发散的。

if_problem.statement_en: The sequence $x_n:=(-1)^n$ diverges, because it has two subsequences $x_{2k}=1$ and $x_{2k+1}=-1$ converging to different limits.
key_techniques: show existence of two different subsequential limits

callouts.title: 例子1.2.4
callouts.body: 序列$x_n:=\sin(n)$的极限不存在。因为我们总是可以在$$I_{A,k}:=(2k\pi+\frac{\pi}{4},2k\pi+\frac{2\pi}{3}),I_{B,k}:=(2k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{4},2k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{3})$$中分别找到两个不同的正整数$n_k,m_k$。相应的因为函数$\sin(x)$在这两个集合上的取值分别为区间$(\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},1)$以及$(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},-1)$因此$$|\sin(n_k)-\sin(m_k)|\geq \sqrt{2},\forall k\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}$$因此柯西判别法告诉我们，序列的极限并不存在。至于为何考虑上述两个区间，其想法可以参考:[[证明正弦函数在整数上取值的序列的极限是不存在的]]其中的2.2节。

if_problem.statement_en: The sequence $x_n:=\sin(n)$ has no limit. Indeed, one can choose positive integers $n_k,m_k$ from the intervals $$I_{A,k}:=(2k\pi+\frac{\pi}{4},2k\pi+\frac{2\pi}{3}),\quad I_{B,k}:=(2k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{4},2k\pi+\frac{5\pi}{3})$$ respectively, so that $$|\sin(n_k)-\sin(m_k)|\geq \sqrt{2},\quad \forall k\in \mathbb{Z}^{+}.$$ Hence the Cauchy criterion shows that the sequence does not converge.
key_techniques: locate integers in carefully chosen intervals

callouts.title: 命题1.2.5:柯西列的一个必要条件
callouts.body: 如果是序列$(a_n)$是柯西列，那么对于任意固定的正整数$p$都有$$|a_{n+p}-a_n|\to 0$$

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 1.2.5: A Necessary Condition for a Cauchy Sequence

if_problem.statement_en: If $(a_n)$ is a Cauchy sequence, then for every fixed positive integer $p$, $$|a_{n+p}-a_n|\to 0.$$
key_techniques: apply the Cauchy condition to shifted indices

callouts.title: 命题1.2.6: 柯西列的一个充分条件
callouts.body: 如果实数(复数)列$(a_n)$满足条件$|a_{n+1}-a_n|\leq b_n$并且$\sum_{n\geq 1}b_n$是一个收敛的级数，那么$a_n$是一个柯西列。

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 1.2.6: A Sufficient Condition for a Cauchy Sequence

if_problem.statement_en: If a real or complex sequence $(a_n)$ satisfies $|a_{n+1}-a_n|\leq b_n$ and the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} b_n$ converges, then $(a_n)$ is a Cauchy sequence.
key_techniques: bound tail differences by tails of a convergent series

callouts.title: 命题1.2.7: 柯西列的一个充分条件的推广
callouts.body: 如果度量空间$(X,d)$当中的序列$(a_n)$满足条件$d(a_{n+1},a_n)\leq b_n$并且$\sum_{n\geq 1}b_n$是一个收敛的级数，那么$a_n$是该度量空间当中的柯西列。

classification_result.english_title: Proposition 1.2.7: Generalization of a Sufficient Condition for a Cauchy Sequence

if_problem.statement_en: If a sequence $(a_n)$ in a metric space $(X,d)$ satisfies $d(a_{n+1},a_n)\leq b_n$ and the series $\sum_{n\geq 1} b_n$ converges, then $(a_n)$ is a Cauchy sequence in that metric space.
key_techniques: telescoping estimate in a metric space
tail control by a convergent series

callouts.title: 函数列逐点收敛的柯西判别
callouts.body: 函数列$f_n(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$逐点收敛到函数$f(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$当且仅当对于任意固定的$x_0$以及任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在正整数$N_{\varepsilon,x_0}$使得任意$n,m>N_{\varepsilon,x_0}$都成立$$|f_n(x_0)-f_m(x_0)|<\varepsilon$$

classification_result.english_title: Cauchy Criterion for Pointwise Convergence of Function Sequences

if_problem.statement_en: A sequence of functions $f_n(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$ converges pointwise to a function $f(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$ if and only if for every fixed $x_0$ and every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a positive integer $N_{\varepsilon,x_0}$ such that for all $n,m>N_{\varepsilon,x_0}$, $$|f_n(x_0)-f_m(x_0)|<\varepsilon.$$
key_techniques: reduce to the scalar Cauchy criterion pointwise
fix a point $x_0$ and apply sequence convergence

callouts.title: 一致收敛的柯西判别
callouts.body: 函数列$f_n(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$一致收敛到函数$f(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$当且仅当对于任意$\varepsilon>0$存在正整数$N_{\varepsilon}$使得任意$n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$都成立$$\sup_{x\in X}|f_n(x)-f_m(x)|<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: A sequence of functions $f_n(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$ converges uniformly to a function $f(x):X\to \mathbb{C}$ if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a positive integer $N_{\varepsilon}$ such that for all $n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$, $$\sup_{x\in X}|f_n(x)-f_m(x)|<\varepsilon.$$
key_techniques: pointwise limit plus uniform tail control

callouts.title: 一致收敛的极限从何而来?
callouts.body: 这个极限可以从逐点收敛而来。因为我们已经证明了函数列逐点收敛的柯西判别。既然现在函数列$f_n(x)$对于每个固定的$x$都满足逐点收敛的柯西判别，那么就必然存在一个极限函数，假设为$f(x)$，那么接下来我们只要估计$\sup_{x\in X}|f_n(x)-f(x)|$，如果能把这个对象找到一个任意小的上界，那么一致收敛就能被证明。

classification_result.english_title: Where Does the Limit in Uniform Convergence Come From?

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Construct the Uniform Limit from Pointwise Limits
if_strategy_template.summary_en: When a function sequence satisfies the uniform Cauchy condition, first use the pointwise Cauchy criterion at each fixed point to define a candidate limit function $f(x)$. Then prove uniform convergence by showing that $\sup_{x\in X}|f_n(x)-f(x)|$ can be made arbitrarily small.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when proving uniform convergence from a uniform Cauchy condition and the existence of the limit function is not given in advance.

callouts.title: Lp空间的柯西收敛判别
callouts.body: $\mu$是装备在$X$上的$\sigma-$finite的测度。函数列$$f_n(x)\in L^p(X\to \mathbb{C},\mu),\infty\geq p\geq 1$$的极限存在,即存在一个$f \in L^p$使得$||f_n-f||_{L^p}\to 0$，当且仅当$\forall \varepsilon>0$存在正整数$N_{\varepsilon}$使得任意$n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$都有$$||f_n-f_m||_{L^p}<\varepsilon$$

if_problem.statement_en: Let $\mu$ be a $\sigma$-finite measure on $X$. For functions $$f_n(x)\in L^p(X\to \mathbb{C},\mu),\quad 1\leq p\leq \infty,$$ there exists an $f\in L^p$ such that $\|f_n-f\|_{L^p}\to 0$ if and only if for every $\varepsilon>0$ there exists a positive integer $N_{\varepsilon}$ such that for all $n,m>N_{\varepsilon}$, $$\|f_n-f_m\|_{L^p}<\varepsilon.$$
key_techniques: Cauchy criterion in a normed space
